info.name: Webex Admin Address Book Workspaces API

params.name: orgId
params.description: List workspaces in this organization. Only admin users of another organization (such as partners) may use this parameter.

params.name: locationId
params.description: Location associated with the workspace. Values must originate from the /locations API and not the legacy /workspaceLocations API.

params.name: workspaceLocationId
params.description: Location associated with the workspace. Both values from the /locations API and the legacy /workspaceLocations API are supported. This field is deprecated and integrations should prefer `locationId` going forward.

params.name: floorId
params.description: Floor associated with the workspace.

params.name: displayName
params.description: List workspaces by display name.

params.name: capacity
params.description: List workspaces with the given capacity. Must be -1 or higher. A value of -1 lists workspaces with no capacity set.

params.name: type
params.description: List workspaces by type.

params.name: start
params.description: Offset. Default is 0.

params.name: max
params.description: Limit the maximum number of workspaces in the response.

params.name: calling
params.description: List workspaces by calling type.

params.name: supportedDevices
params.description: List workspaces by supported devices.

params.name: calendar
params.description: List workspaces by calendar type.

params.name: deviceHostedMeetingsEnabled
params.description: List workspaces enabled for device hosted meetings.

params.name: devicePlatform
params.description: List workspaces by device platform.

params.name: healthLevel
params.description: List workspaces by health level.

params.name: includeDevices
params.description: Flag identifying whether to include the devices associated with the workspace in the response.

params.name: includeCapabilities
params.description: Flag identifying whether to include the workspace capabilities in the response.

params.name: plannedMaintenance
params.description: List workspaces with given maintenance mode.

params.name: customAttribute
params.description: List workspaces with given custom attribute key.

items.docs:
List workspaces.

Use query parameters to filter the response. The `orgId` parameter can only be used by admin users of another organization (such as partners). The `locationId`, `workspaceLocationId`, `indoorNavigation`, `floorId`, `capacity` and `type` fields will only be present for workspaces that have a value set for them. The special values `notSet` (for filtering on category) and `-1` (for filtering on capacity) can be used to filter for workspaces without a type and/or capacity.

Create a workspace.

The `locationId`, `workspaceLocationId`, `floorId`, `indoorNavigation`, `capacity`, `type`, `notes` and `hotdeskingStatus` parameters are optional, and omitting them will result in the creation of a workspace without these values set, or set to their default. A `locationId` must be provided when the `floorId` is set. Calendar and calling can also be set for a new workspace. Omitting them will default to free calling and no calendaring. Shows details for a workspace, by ID.

The `locationId`, `workspaceLocationId`, `floorId`, `indoorNavigation`, `capacity`, `type` and `notes` fields will only be present if they have been set for the workspace. Specify the workspace ID in the `workspaceId` parameter in the URI.

params.name: workspaceId
params.description: A unique identifier for the workspace.

items.docs:
Updates details for a workspace by ID.

Specify the workspace ID in the `workspaceId` parameter in the URI. Include all details for the workspace that are present in a [GET request for the workspace details](/docs/api/v1/workspaces/get-workspace-details). Not including the optional `capacity`, `type` or `notes` fields will result in the fields no longer being defined for the workspace. A `locationId` must be provided when the `floorId` is set. items.docs:
Deletes a workspace by ID.

Also deletes all devices associated with the workspace. Any deleted devices will need to be reactivated. Specify the workspace ID in the `workspaceId` parameter in the URI.

params.name: workspaceId
params.description: A unique identifier for the workspace.

items.docs:
Shows the capabilities for a workspace by ID.

Returns a set of capabilities, including whether or not the capability is supported by any device in the workspace, and if the capability is configured (enabled). For example for a specific capability like `occupancyDetection`, the API will return if the capability is supported and/or configured such that occupancy detection data will flow from the workspace (device) to the cloud. Specify the workspace ID in the `workspaceId` parameter in the URI.
